dueSoon.title: Code review: design, logic, standards, and recommendations ## Scope - Reviewed `main@010cbeb` across `package.json`, `config.json`, `.env.example`, `README.md`, `.github/workflows/*.yml`, `src/*.mjs`, `web/*`, and `test/zero-scroll.test.mjs`. - Verified syntax via `node --check` on all 17 `.mjs`/`.js` files (passed). Note: `node --test` could not complete in an un-installed checkout because `src/delivery.mjs` imports `nodemailer` (`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` without `npm install`). ## Design, Logic & Standards Assessment - **Design & Architecture**: Very cohesive, practical architecture for a zero-hosting-cost personal productivity ledger. Clean separation of parsing (`src/parser.mjs`), atomic JSON persistence (`src/store.mjs`), news/feed aggregation (`src/news.mjs`), summarization (`src/summarizer.mjs`), notification rendering/delivery (`src/delivery.mjs`), local API/static server (`src/server.mjs`), and GitHub Actions automation (`.github/workflows/*.yml`). Supporting three modes in one browser UI (`local`, `github` Contents API sync, and offline `localStorage`) is well executed. - **Logic & Correctness**: Most core flows (ICS folding/TZID parsing, 24h/2h/overdue reminder stages, URL canonicalization/deduplication, atomic temp-file writes, Discord 6000-char embed budget trimming) are thoughtfully implemented. A few subtle bugs exist around `trustedSources` substring matching, `summarizedBy` reporting, dry-run side effects, `PUT /api/config` key stripping, and `web/app.js` Undo/parser parity. - **Standards & Hygiene**: Uses DOM node construction + `.textContent` consistently in `web/app.js` (avoiding `innerHTML` XSS), `AbortSignal.timeout` on external network requests, SHA-less standard GitHub actions (`checkout@v4`, `setup-node@v4`), and strong end-to-end test coverage with mocked `fetch` in `test/zero-scroll.test.mjs`. Main gaps are missing CI execution of `npm test` and potential workflow `git push` race conditions. **Strengths** - `src/store.mjs:20-26`: Atomic temp-file-then-rename JSON writes (`writeJson`) protect `data/*.json` from partial writes. - `src/delivery.mjs:286-315`: Enforces Discord's embed count and character budget (`charBudget = 5600`) cleanly so oversized news/read-later payloads don't fail webhook delivery. - `src/news.mjs:86-97` & `104-114`: Strips tracking query parameters (`utm_*`, `fbclid`, `gclid`, `oc`, `ref`) before deduplicating and prunes stale `seen.json` entries after 30 days. ## Bugs & Small Problems - **`src/news.mjs:116-124` — `trustedSources` check allows `t.includes(norm)` false positives**: - `matchesTrustedSource` checks `norm === t || norm.includes(t) || t.includes(norm)` (`src/news.mjs:122`). Because `t.includes(norm)` matches when a feed's publisher name is any substring of a trusted outlet name, generic or short publisher names like `"News"`, `"Media"`, `"The"`, or `"Times"` match `"404 Media"`, `"BBC News"`/`"The Information"`, or `"Financial Times"`, bypassing the allowlist. - Fix: Match exact normalized names (or strict word-boundary / domain suffix rules) instead of symmetric `t.includes(norm)`. - **`src/news.mjs:166` — Per-topic `excludePatterns` lacks `try/catch` around `new RegExp`**: - `globalExcludes` wraps `new RegExp(p, 'i')` in `try/catch` (`src/news.mjs:143-149`), whereas per-topic `t.excludePatterns` (`src/news.mjs:166`) calls `new RegExp(p, 'i')` directly. A malformed regex in `config.json` crashes the entire briefing run. - Fix: Extract a shared `compilePatterns(list)` helper with `try/catch` for both global and per-topic patterns. - **`src/summarizer.mjs:229,272` — `summarizedBy` misreports `'gemini'` when Gemini fails or is skipped**: - At `src/summarizer.mjs:272`, `summarizedBy: geminiApiKey && bullets ? 'gemini' : 'extractive'` checks `bullets` after lines `255-263` have already populated `bullets` with the extractive fallback! So whenever `GEMINI_API_KEY` is configured and `summarizeWithGemini` throws, returns `null`, or is skipped (`article.text.length <= 100`), the record still claims `summarizedBy: 'gemini'`. Same issue in the YouTube branch (`src/summarizer.mjs:229`). - Fix: Track `let usedGemini = false;` when `summarizeWithGemini` returns non-empty bullets. - **`src/server.mjs:157-170` — `PUT /api/config` silently drops `news.maxAgeDays` and `news.excludePatterns`**: - `PUT /api/config` replaces `news` with `{ topics, feeds }` (`src/server.mjs:163-166`), discarding `config.news.maxAgeDays` (`config.json:21`) and `config.news.excludePatterns` (`config.json:22-30`), as well as `briefing` / `reminders` if modified. - Fix: Spread `...config.news` (`news: { ...config.news, topics: ..., feeds: ... }`). - **`src/server.mjs:180-184` — Static file containment check lacks a path separator**: - `if (!resolved.startsWith(path.resolve(paths.webDir)))` (`src/server.mjs:182`) allows a sibling directory sharing the `web` prefix (e.g., `web-private/...`) to pass `startsWith`. - Fix: Check `const webRoot = path.resolve(paths.webDir);` and require `resolved === webRoot || resolved.startsWith(webRoot + path.sep)`. - **`src/briefing.mjs:102` & `.github/workflows/morning-briefing.yml:42-55` — Dry-run writes and commits `data/last-briefing.json`**: - `writeJson(paths.lastBriefing, briefing)` (`src/briefing.mjs:102`) executes even when `dryRun: true`, and `.github/workflows/morning-briefing.yml:48-55` commits `data/last-briefing.json` without checking whether `inputs.dry_run == 'true'`. - Fix: Guard `writeJson(paths.lastBriefing, briefing)` (or the CI commit step) when running `--dry-run` in CI. - **`src/readlater.mjs:32-37` & `web/app.js:527,564` — `saveReadLater(..., { skipFetch: true })` does not reject `javascript:`/`data:` URLs**: - `summarizeUrl` validates `/^https?:$/i.test(parsedUrl.protocol)` (`src/summarizer.mjs:169`), but when `skipFetch` is `true`, `saveReadLater` (`src/readlater.mjs:33-37`) only validates `new URL(rawUrl)` and accepts non-HTTP protocols, which `web/app.js:527,564` renders into `<a href="...">` and `src/delivery.mjs:104,124` renders into HTML emails. - Fix: Enforce `https?` in `saveReadLater` (before checking `skipFetch`) and verify safe `http:`/`https:` schemes before setting `a.href` in `web/app.js`. - **`.github/workflows/morning-briefing.yml`, `reminders.yml`, `issue-capture.yml` — Concurrent `git push` race conditions**: - All three workflows commit and push to `main`, yet none configure a shared `concurrency` group or `git pull --rebase` before `git push`. Overlapping runs (e.g., hourly `reminders` + `morning-briefing` or `issue-capture`) can fail on non-fast-forward pushes. - Fix: Add a shared `concurrency` group (e.g. `group: data-branch-write`, `cancel-in-progress: false`) across workflows that push to `main`, or rebase-and-retry on push. - **`web/app.js:65-206` vs `src/parser.mjs` — Client parser diverges from backend parser**: - `parseClientCapture` (`web/app.js:65-206`) omits `YYYY-MM-DD` ISO dates (`src/parser.mjs:176-190`), explicit years on month-day strings (`src/parser.mjs:194`), `in N weeks` (`src/parser.mjs:140`), and `low` priority detection (`src/parser.mjs:288-290`). - **`web/app.js:857-885` & `914-942` — Undo UI and restoration fidelity**: - `scheduleUndo` runs before `fetch('/api/inbox/...')` / `persistGitHubList(...)` settles, leaving the Undo banner visible even if deletion fails; in `local` mode, Undo re-POSTs `/api/dump` (`web/app.js:861-865`), which re-parses the text and loses custom `dueAt` edits, completion timestamps, and `remindedStages`. - **`src/inbox.mjs:69-72` & `src/parser.mjs:176-190` — Date validation edge cases**: - `updateInboxItem` (`src/inbox.mjs:70`) calls `new Date(patch.dueAt).toISOString()` without validating `!Number.isNaN(...)`, throwing `RangeError` on invalid input; `extractDueDate` (`src/parser.mjs:176-187`) allows invalid calendar dates like ` ` to roll over into March via `Date.UTC`. ## Recommendations & Suggestions - **Add a CI test workflow (`.github/workflows/test.yml`)**: `test/zero-scroll.test.mjs` is solid and fast, but no workflow currently runs `npm test` on pushes or pull requests. - **Serve/bundle shared parser logic (`src/parser.mjs` -> `web/`)**: Serving `src/parser.mjs` (or sharing a pure-ESM `shared/parser.mjs` module copied during `deploy-pages.yml`) eliminates drift between `src/parser.mjs` and `web/app.js:parseClientCapture`. - **Reconcile remote JSON before `ghWriteJson` (`web/app.js:233-262`)**: In `github` mode, merge added/updated/deleted item IDs against the freshly fetched `existing.data.items` before `PUT` so background `morning-briefing` / `reminders` commits on `main` aren't overwritten by a stale phone tab. - **Cache `web/manifest.webmanifest` in `web/sw.js:2`**: Add `./manifest.webmanifest` to `ASSETS`, and document/bump `CACHE_NAME` when deploying `web/` updates. ## Prioritized Checklist - [ ] [High] Tighten `matchesTrustedSource` (`src/news.mjs:116-124`) to stop `t.includes(norm)` allowlist bypasses - [ ] [High] Add shared `concurrency` (or rebase-before-push) across `morning-briefing.yml`, `reminders.yml`, and `issue-capture.yml` - [ ] [High] Enforce `http:`/`https:` URL schemes in `src/readlater.mjs:32-37` and `web/app.js:527,564` - [ ] [Medium] Fix `PUT /api/config` (`src/server.mjs:163-166`) so `maxAgeDays`/`excludePatterns` aren't dropped, and fix `path.sep` check at `src/server.mjs:182` - [ ] [Medium] Fix `summarizedBy` fallback attribution (`src/summarizer.mjs:229,272`) and wrap topic `excludePatterns` regex compilation in `try/catch` (`src/news.mjs:166`) - [ ] [Medium] Add a GitHub Actions workflow running `npm test` on push/PR - [ ] [Low] Prevent `brief:dry` from committing `data/last-briefing.json` in `morning-briefing.yml`, validate `patch.dueAt` (`src/inbox.mjs:70`), and align `web/app.js` parser/undo behavior with `src/parser.mjs`

**Strengths**
- `src/store.mjs:20-26`: Atomic temp-file-then-rename JSON writes (`writeJson`) protect `data/*.json` from partial writes.
- `src/delivery.mjs:286-315`: Enforces Discord's embed count and character budget (`charBudget = 5600`) cleanly so oversized news/read-later payloads don't fail webhook delivery.
- `src/news.mjs:86-97` & `104-114`: Strips tracking query parameters (`utm_*`, `fbclid`, `gclid`, `oc`, `ref`) before deduplicating and prunes stale `seen.json` entries after 30 days.

## Bugs & Small Problems

- **`src/news.mjs:116-124` — `trustedSources` check allows `t.includes(norm)` false positives**:
  - `matchesTrustedSource` checks `norm === t || norm.includes(t) || t.includes(norm)` (`src/news.mjs:122`). Because `t.includes(norm)` matches when a feed's publisher name is any substring of a trusted outlet name, generic or short publisher names like `"News"`, `"Media"`, `"The"`, or `"Times"` match `"404 Media"`, `"BBC News"`/`"The Information"`, or `"Financial Times"`, bypassing the allowlist.
  - Fix: Match exact normalized names (or strict word-boundary / domain suffix rules) instead of symmetric `t.includes(norm)`.
- **`src/news.mjs:166` — Per-topic `excludePatterns` lacks `try/catch` around `new RegExp`**:
  - `globalExcludes` wraps `new RegExp(p, 'i')` in `try/catch` (`src/news.mjs:143-149`), whereas per-topic `t.excludePatterns` (`src/news.mjs:166`) calls `new RegExp(p, 'i')` directly. A malformed regex in `config.json` crashes the entire briefing run.
  - Fix: Extract a shared `compilePatterns(list)` helper with `try/catch` for both global and per-topic patterns.
- **`src/summarizer.mjs:229,272` — `summarizedBy` misreports `'gemini'` when Gemini fails or is skipped**:
  - At `src/summarizer.mjs:272`, `summarizedBy: geminiApiKey && bullets ? 'gemini' : 'extractive'` checks `bullets` after lines `255-263` have already populated `bullets` with the extractive fallback! So whenever `GEMINI_API_KEY` is configured and `summarizeWithGemini` throws, returns `null`, or is skipped (`article.text.length <= 100`), the record still claims `summarizedBy: 'gemini'`. Same issue in the YouTube branch (`src/summarizer.mjs:229`).
  - Fix: Track `let usedGemini = false;` when `summarizeWithGemini` returns non-empty bullets.
- **`src/server.mjs:157-170` — `PUT /api/config` silently drops `news.maxAgeDays` and `news.excludePatterns`**:

  - Fix: Spread `...config.news` (`news: { ...config.news, topics: ..., feeds: ... }`).
- **`src/server.mjs:180-184` — Static file containment check lacks a path separator**:
  - `if (!resolved.startsWith(path.resolve(paths.webDir)))` (`src/server.mjs:182`) allows a sibling directory sharing the `web` prefix (e.g., `web-private/...`) to pass `startsWith`.
  - Fix: Check `const webRoot = path.resolve(paths.webDir);` and require `resolved === webRoot || resolved.startsWith(webRoot + path.sep)`.
- **`src/briefing.mjs:102` & `.github/workflows/morning-briefing.yml:42-55` — Dry-run writes and commits `data/last-briefing.json`**:
  - `writeJson(paths.lastBriefing, briefing)` (`src/briefing.mjs:102`) executes even when `dryRun: true`, and `.github/workflows/morning-briefing.yml:48-55` commits `data/last-briefing.json` without checking whether `inputs.dry_run == 'true'`.
  - Fix: Guard `writeJson(paths.lastBriefing, briefing)` (or the CI commit step) when running `--dry-run` in CI.
- **`src/readlater.mjs:32-37` & `web/app.js:527,564` — `saveReadLater(..., { skipFetch: true })` does not reject `javascript:`/`data:` URLs**:
  - `summarizeUrl` validates `/^https?:$/i.test(parsedUrl.protocol)` (`src/summarizer.mjs:169`), but when `skipFetch` is `true`, `saveReadLater` (`src/readlater.mjs:33-37`) only validates `new URL(rawUrl)` and accepts non-HTTP protocols, which `web/app.js:527,564` renders into `<a href="...">` and `src/delivery.mjs:104,124` renders into HTML emails.
  - Fix: Enforce `https?` in `saveReadLater` (before checking `skipFetch`) and verify safe `http:`/`https:` schemes before setting `a.href` in `web/app.js`.
- **`.github/workflows/morning-briefing.yml`, `reminders.yml`, `issue-capture.yml` — Concurrent `git push` race conditions**:
  - All three workflows commit and push to `main`, yet none configure a shared `concurrency` group or `git pull --rebase` before `git push`. Overlapping runs (e.g., hourly `reminders` + `morning-briefing` or `issue-capture`) can fail on non-fast-forward pushes.
  - Fix: Add a shared `concurrency` group (e.g. `group: data-branch-write`, `cancel-in-progress: false`) across workflows that push to `main`, or rebase-and-retry on push.
- **`web/app.js:65-206` vs `src/parser.mjs` — Client parser diverges from backend parser**:
  - `parseClientCapture` (`web/app.js:65-206`) omits `YYYY-MM-DD` ISO dates (`src/parser.mjs:176-190`), explicit years on month-day strings (`src/parser.mjs:194`), `in N weeks` (`src/parser.mjs:140`), and `low` priority detection (`src/parser.mjs:288-290`).
- **`web/app.js:857-885` & `914-942` — Undo UI and restoration fidelity**:
  - `scheduleUndo` runs before `fetch('/api/inbox/...')` / `persistGitHubList(...)` settles, leaving the Undo banner visible even if deletion fails; in `local` mode, Undo re-POSTs `/api/dump` (`web/app.js:861-865`), which re-parses the text and loses custom `dueAt` edits, completion timestamps, and `remindedStages`.

## Recommendations & Suggestions

- **Add a CI test workflow (`.github/workflows/test.yml`)**: `test/zero-scroll.test.mjs` is solid and fast, but no workflow currently runs `npm test` on pushes or pull requests.
- **Serve/bundle shared parser logic (`src/parser.mjs` -> `web/`)**: Serving `src/parser.mjs` (or sharing a pure-ESM `shared/parser.mjs` module copied during `deploy-pages.yml`) eliminates drift between `src/parser.mjs` and `web/app.js:parseClientCapture`.
- **Reconcile remote JSON before `ghWriteJson` (`web/app.js:233-262`)**: In `github` mode, merge added/updated/deleted item IDs against the freshly fetched `existing.data.items` before `PUT` so background `morning-briefing` / `reminders` commits on `main` aren't overwritten by a stale phone tab.
- **Cache `web/manifest.webmanifest` in `web/sw.js:2`**: Add `./manifest.webmanifest` to `ASSETS`, and document/bump `CACHE_NAME` when deploying `web/` updates.

## Prioritized Checklist

- [ ] [High] Tighten `matchesTrustedSource` (`src/news.mjs:116-124`) to stop `t.includes(norm)` allowlist bypasses
- [ ] [High] Add shared `concurrency` (or rebase-before-push) across `morning-briefing.yml`, `reminders.yml`, and `issue-capture.yml`
- [ ] [High] Enforce `http:`/`https:` URL schemes in `src/readlater.mjs:32-37` and `web/app.js:527,564`
- [ ] [Medium] Fix `PUT /api/config` (`src/server.mjs:163-166`) so `maxAgeDays`/`excludePatterns` aren't dropped, and fix `path.sep` check at `src/server.mjs:182`
- [ ] [Medium] Fix `summarizedBy` fallback attribution (`src/summarizer.mjs:229,272`) and wrap topic `excludePatterns` regex compilation in `try/catch` (`src/news.mjs:166`)
- [ ] [Medium] Add a GitHub Actions workflow running `npm test` on push/PR
- [ ] [Low] Prevent `brief:dry` from committing `data/last-briefing.json` in `morning-briefing.yml`, validate `patch.dueAt` (`src/inbox.mjs:70`), and align `web/app.js` parser/undo behavior with `src/parser.mjs`

readLater.note: The 24-hour reminder can be sent after the 2-hour reminder With lead times `[24, 2]`, add a task due at 10:00 UTC and first evaluate it at 08:30. The evaluator returns `2h`. Save that stage and evaluate again at 09:30. It returns `24h`, so the second alert is less urgent even though the deadline is closer. Reproduced by calling `evaluateDueReminders` twice with those timestamps and carrying the first result forward in `remindedStages`. Once a more urgent stage has fired, suppress less urgent stages for that deadline. The overdue stage should still be eligible. [Reminder stage selection]( )
